body:
Extend post and machine support to the secondary **Laguna Swift** and **Grizzly** CNC router controllers identified in #1907 research, after the RichAuto DSP A11 slice proves on hardware.

## Scope (OEM manuals only)

1. **WinCNC** (earlier Laguna `MCNC Swift` models):
   - Supports `.tap`/`.nc`, square-bracket comments `[...]`, `G20` / `G21` (note `G22` in older manuals), `G91.1`, `L91`, `G53` machine coordinates, `G4 X<sec>` dwell in seconds, `G81`/`G83`, `G43` + `M37` macros, and scripted `M6`.
2. **DSP-J2** (`Grizzly G0403` benchtop):
   - Requires plain **ANSI** text (no UTF-8 BOM) on FAT16/FAT32 USB drives, `G20`/`G21`, `G00`-`G03`, `M03`-`M05`, manual `M6` lift, and expanded plain-move drilling.
3. **RichAuto DSP B18 4-axis** (`Grizzly G0932`):
   - Same core RichAuto dialect as A11 plus 4th rotary `C` axis (`51-3/16"` x `98-7/16"` x `7-7/8"` Z, `7-7/8"` C swing, 472 IPM C rapid, 4 HP 0-18,000 RPM stated, ER25).
4. **Siemens Sinumerik 808D Advanced** (`Grizzly G0934` 5' x 10' 8-pos rotary ATC):
   - Evaluate and adapt `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` for `808D Advanced` native Siemens mode (`G290`, `CYCLE81`-`CYCLE84`) vs ISO dialect mode (`G291`, `G81`) and `.MPF` USB loading (`59-1/16"` x `118-1/8"` x `7-7/8"` Z, 12 HP 0-24,000 RPM, ER32).

## Order

Hold implementation behind the `RichAuto DSP A11` post, machine files, and test-cut kit so real hardware feedback stabilizes our shop-router baseline first.

## Done means

- Each target controller has documented OEM dialect rules and either its own `.cps` post or verified support in an existing post with conformance goldens.
- Machine `.mch` definitions pass `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` and map to their matching posts in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`.

Part of #1907
